# Product documentation

- Use `docs/README.md` as the map to this project's business and technical documentation.
- Read the documents relevant to the current task; do not assume that all documentation has been loaded.
- Business docs describe agreed intended behavior. Code and tests show implemented behavior.
- Do not invent missing requirements or rules. Report unclear or conflicting sources.
- When a change affects a documented business flow, rule, requirement, or technical design, update the relevant doc in the same change and include source references.
